title: Brandon Blazio - Da Love
htmlContent:
Brandon Blazio makes you feel on top of the world on his new song “Da Love”. The production has a championship sound to it, as Brandon Blazio lyrically shows off his rings he’s earned throughout his career. His high energy signature flow shines more than ever, as you can hear the underlying hunger in his voice that gives the song it extra level soul, as you feel he knows everything you’ve been through, and now it’s time to celebrate how far you’ve come.
